workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Queries SMP/E for applied, held, and errored PTFs in a target zone

variable.name: CSI_DATASET
variable.label: CSI Dataset Name
variable.abstract: Fully qualified name of the SMP/E global CSI dataset (e.g. SYS1.GLOBAL.CSI)
variable.description: The SMP/E global CSI (Consolidated Software Inventory) dataset. This is the master catalog of all SMP/E-managed software on the system. All GIMSMP queries are directed at this dataset.

variable.name: TARGET_ZONE
variable.label: Target Zone Name
variable.abstract: SMP/E target zone to query (e.g. TZONE)
variable.description: The name of the SMP/E target zone to query for applied PTFs. Use ISPF 3.4 or LISTCAT against the CSI to find zone names if unknown.

variable.name: FMID_FILTER
variable.label: FMID Filter (optional)
variable.abstract: Limit the PTF query to a specific FMID (e.g. AZWE003 for Zowe). Leave blank for all FMIDs.
variable.description: When set, the listAppliedPtfs step filters the GIMSMP output to show only PTFs belonging to this FMID. Leave blank to report all PTFs in the target zone. Zowe V3 FMID is AZWE003.

variable.name: REPORT_PATH
variable.label: Report Output Path
variable.abstract: USS path where the PTF status report will be written
variable.description: The full USS path for the PTF status report output file.

step.name: checkCsi
step.title: Confirm CSI Dataset Exists
step.description: Runs LISTCAT against the CSI dataset name to confirm it exists and is accessible before running GIMSMP queries.
step.instructions:
Runs tsocmd LISTCAT ENT(${instance-CSI_DATASET}) to confirm the CSI dataset exists and is accessible to this user ID.
PASS : LISTCAT returns data for the dataset FAIL : Dataset not found or not accessible
If this fails, verify the CSI name with your SMP/E administrator. Common names: SYS1.GLOBAL.CSI, SMPE.GLOBAL.CSI, or a product-specific CSI.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh CSI="${instance-CSI_DATASET}" echo "=== CSI Dataset Check ===" echo "CSI : $CSI" echo "-------------------------" OUT=$(tsocmd "LISTCAT ENT($CSI)" 2>&1) RC=$? echo "$OUT" | head -20 echo "-------------------------" if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (CSI dataset $CSI found, RC=0)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (LISTCAT returned RC=$RC - check CSI name and access)" fi

step.name: listAppliedPtfs
step.title: List Applied PTFs
step.description: Submits a GIMSMP QUERY SYSMODS job to list all PTFs applied in the target zone. If FMID_FILTER is set, filters output to that FMID only.
step.instructions:
Runs GIMSMP with SET BDY(${instance-TARGET_ZONE}) and QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) APPLYCHECK to list all PTFs.
If FMID_FILTER is set to ${instance-FMID_FILTER}, the output is filtered to that FMID only.
Review the output to confirm the expected PTFs are applied before or after a maintenance window.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh CSI="${instance-CSI_DATASET}" ZONE="${instance-TARGET_ZONE}" FMID="${instance-FMID_FILTER}" FMID_LABEL="$FMID" if [ -z "$FMID_LABEL" ]; then FMID_LABEL="ALL"; fi echo "=== Applied PTFs ===" echo "CSI : $CSI" echo "Zone : $ZONE" echo "FMID : $FMID_LABEL" echo "--------------------" SMPCNTL=" SET BDY($ZONE) . QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) APPLYCHECK ." TMPCTL="/tmp/smpe_query_$$.txt" echo "$SMPCNTL" > "$TMPCTL" OUT=$(tsocmd "EXEC '$CSI' 'SMPCNTL'" 2>&1) OUT2=$(echo " SET BDY($ZONE) . QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) APPLYCHECK ." | tsocmd "GIMSMP CSI('$CSI')" 2>&1) RC=$? rm -f "$TMPCTL" 2>/dev/null if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "Note: direct GIMSMP via tsocmd returned RC=$RC" echo "Attempting via IKJEFT01..." OUT3=$(tsocmd "GIMSMP CSI('$CSI') SET BDY($ZONE) . QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) APPLYCHECK ." 2>&1) echo "$OUT3" | head -100 else echo "$OUT2" | head -100 fi echo "--------------------" if [ -n "$FMID" ]; then echo "--- Filtered to FMID: $FMID ---" echo "$OUT2" | grep "$FMID" | head -50 fi echo "RESULT : PTF query attempted - review output above"

step.name: listHoldPtfs
step.title: List PTFs in HOLD Status
step.description: Queries SMP/E for any PTFs in HOLD status in the target zone. HOLD PTFs block apply processing and must be resolved before installing dependent PTFs.
step.instructions:
Queries CSI ${instance-CSI_DATASET} zone ${instance-TARGET_ZONE} for PTFs with HOLD status.
PASS : No PTFs in HOLD status WARN : One or more PTFs are held
A HOLD condition means IBM has issued a HOLDDATA record against the PTF — usually due to a defect, dependency, or PE (product error). Each held PTF must be investigated before the hold is bypassed or the PTF is skipped.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh CSI="${instance-CSI_DATASET}" ZONE="${instance-TARGET_ZONE}" echo "=== PTFs in HOLD Status ===" echo "CSI : $CSI" echo "Zone : $ZONE" echo "---------------------------" OUT=$(tsocmd "GIMSMP CSI('$CSI') SET BDY($ZONE) . QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) HOLD ." 2>&1) RC=$? echo "$OUT" | head -80 echo "---------------------------" HOLD_COUNT=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -c "HOLD" 2>/dev/null) if [ "$HOLD_COUNT" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : WARN ($HOLD_COUNT HOLD reference(s) found - review before applying PTFs)" else echo "RESULT : PASS (no HOLD PTFs found in zone $ZONE)" fi

step.name: listErrorPtfs
step.title: List PTFs in ERROR Status
step.description: Queries SMP/E for any PTFs in ERROR status in the target zone. ERROR PTFs indicate a failed apply or receive operation that needs remediation.
step.instructions:
Queries CSI ${instance-CSI_DATASET} zone ${instance-TARGET_ZONE} for PTFs with ERROR status.
PASS : No PTFs in ERROR status FAIL : One or more PTFs in ERROR status
An ERROR status means a previous SMP/E apply or receive operation failed and left the zone in an inconsistent state. These must be resolved before running further SMP/E operations.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh CSI="${instance-CSI_DATASET}" ZONE="${instance-TARGET_ZONE}" echo "=== PTFs in ERROR Status ===" echo "CSI : $CSI" echo "Zone : $ZONE" echo "----------------------------" OUT=$(tsocmd "GIMSMP CSI('$CSI') SET BDY($ZONE) . QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) STATUS(ERROR) ." 2>&1) RC=$? echo "$OUT" | head -80 echo "----------------------------" ERR_COUNT=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -ic "error" 2>/dev/null) if [ $RC -eq 0 ] && [ "$ERR_COUNT" -eq 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : PASS (no ERROR PTFs found in zone $ZONE)" else echo "RESULT : WARN (ERROR references found or RC=$RC - review output)" fi

step.name: approvalGate
step.title: PTF Report Sign-Off
step.description: Manual step. Operator reviews all PTF query outputs and signs off before the final report is written.
step.instructions:
Review the spool output from all preceding steps:
checkCsi — CSI dataset accessible? listAppliedPtfs — PTFs applied for ${instance-FMID_FILTER}? listHoldPtfs — Any HOLD PTFs to investigate? listErrorPtfs — Any ERROR PTFs to remediate?
Mark this step complete when you are satisfied the PTF status has been reviewed and documented.

step.name: writeReport
step.title: Write PTF Status Report
step.description: Writes a timestamped PTF status report to REPORT_PATH on USS and surfaces it on the JES spool for archiving or attaching to a change record.
step.instructions:
Writes the PTF status report to ${instance-REPORT_PATH}.
Attach this report to the change record for the maintenance window. Run this workflow before and after PTF application to produce a before/after comparison.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh REPORT="${instance-REPORT_PATH}" TS=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') echo "Writing PTF status report to $REPORT" echo "============================================================" > "$REPORT" echo " SMP/E PTF Status Report" >> "$REPORT" echo " Generated : $TS" >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "CONFIGURATION" >> "$REPORT" echo " CSI dataset : ${instance-CSI_DATASET}" >> "$REPORT" echo " Target zone : ${instance-TARGET_ZONE}" >> "$REPORT" echo " FMID filter : ${instance-FMID_FILTER}" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "QUERIES PERFORMED" >> "$REPORT" echo " 1. CSI accessible - see checkCsi step output" >> "$REPORT" echo " 2. Applied PTFs - see listAppliedPtfs output" >> "$REPORT" echo " 3. PTFs in HOLD status - see listHoldPtfs output" >> "$REPORT" echo " 4. PTFs in ERROR status - see listErrorPtfs output" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "SIGN-OFF" >> "$REPORT" echo " Reviewed at : $TS" >> "$REPORT" echo " Workflow : smpe-ptf-status v1.0" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo " Attach to change record for maintenance window evidence." >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo "" echo "=== Report written to $REPORT ===" cat "$REPORT"
